name: turn_solo
title: Turn solo: settle -> 90 deg footwork turn -> decel-stop -> hold
summary: Show the footwork turn specialist (wr_stepturn) BY ITSELF: the G1 settles to a stand, then turns ~90 deg by REAL footwork (BATON solo-turn context; crane-yaw auto-OFF => wtz=0, pure footwork, no rope), decelerates to a stop, holds. The turn is at its most reliable from a clean stand (in-sequence variance comes from the walk->turn handoff, not the turn itself). Uses the walker (wr_navigator) only as the warmup/settle context.
_turn_note: This published demo remains pinned to the verified wr_stepturn/ghost_turn_180 configuration. The g1_turn_in_place skill default is the newer experimental natural four-footfall policy; sequence.env deliberately overrides it until that policy has its own end-to-end certification.
props: ghost turn reference (yawlock) beside the robot

verification.support: G1 lambda=0.9 weight-bearing balance harness; zero yaw torque; not free-standing
verification.result: Pinned wr_stepturn configuration turns ~86-90 deg CCW by footwork from a clean stand, upright, and holds on the weight-bearing balance harness
